title: Personalizing Personal Health Interfaces: Co-Design with Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.15046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personal health interfaces present wellbeing data through standardized dashboards that rarely fit how people interpret or act on it. Personalizing them to what people would like to see for themselves often requires design and technical expertise, a barrier that generative AI may potentially lower. Therefore, we ask what designs emerge and how it enables and constrains the design process. We conducted a co-design study where 14 participants redesigned Google and Apple Health interfaces using Figma Make. Participants reimagined interfaces that supported personal context, future planning, and interactive experiences, yet conversational AI designs converged around chat-window conventions. AI helped materialize loosely articulated ideas, but model defaults and generation latency shaped iteration. translated_title: 个人健康界面的个性化：与生成式AI的协同设计
translated_abstract: 个人健康界面通过标准化的仪表盘呈现健康数据，但这些仪表盘很少契合人们解读数据和据此行动的方式。将界面个性化为人们自己希望看到的样子，通常需要设计和专业技术知识，而生成式AI可能有助于降低这一门槛。因此，我们探究了会涌现出哪些设计，以及生成式AI如何促进和限制设计过程。我们开展了一项协同设计研究，让14名参与者使用Figma Make重新设计Google和Apple Health的界面。参与者重新构想了支持个人情境、未来规划和交互体验的界面，但对话式AI的设计趋向于聊天窗口的惯用模式。AI帮助将模糊的想法具体化，但模型的默认设置和生成延迟影响了迭代过程。这一流程更容易实现可解释性和问责性，而较难处理隐私、信任和情感安全。生成式协同设计让……
tldr: 通过让14名参与者使用生成式AI工具协同重新设计个人健康界面，研究发现生成式AI能帮助非专业用户将模糊的个性化设计想法具体化，但聊天窗口的设计惯例、模型默认设置和生成延迟也限制了设计多样性与迭代，且隐私、信任等价值较难在流程中落地。
en_tdlr: A co-design study with 14 participants using generative AI to redesign personal health interfaces shows that AI helps non-experts materialize loosely articulated personalization ideas, though chat-window conventions, model defaults, and generation latency constrain design diversity and iteration, and values like privacy and trust are harder to operationalize.
